overview.en:
Analyze construction jobs, profitability and invoicing with Knowify’s official read-only AI connector.

Analyze construction project and billing data through the read-only connector. Keep the project and accounting period explicit when reviewing profitability.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Knowify 官方只读 AI 连接器分析施工项目、利润与开票数据。

通过只读连接器分析施工项目与开票数据，检查盈利情况时明确项目和会计期间。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this construction project's available financial information.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个施工项目的可用财务信息。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available billing data for this project.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个项目的可用开票数据。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a project profitability review for the selected period.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为选定周期准备项目盈利复盘。
